Rasdaman is an array database and geospatial analytics platform for managing and processing multi-dimensional raster data via OGC-compliant web services. It is used for scalable Earth observation and scientific data infrastructures.
name: Rasdaman
CartoVista
description: CartoVista is a commercial interactive web-mapping platform with cloud and self-hosted publishing options. CartoVista Server portals expose paths such as /CartoVistaServer/maps/view and load versioned cartovistawebportal-* assets. The platform publishes map galleries, interactive thematic maps, dashboards, and linked data views.

name: mOBEC
description: mOBEC is T-MAPY's municipal map portal for smaller Slovak towns and villages. Public tenants live at mobec.sk/{slug} (optional hash-base path), load /img/tmapyn.svg, set a numeric tenant ido, and title the public map Všeobecná mapa. Distinct from GISPLAN Spinbox galleries (gisplan) on {city}.gisplan.sk. Staff login chrome on the same SPA does not make the public map a non-catalog.

name: GISApp
description: GISApp is Fida Solutions / Urbanova municipal GIS used by Romanian cities. Tenants live at {city}.gisapp.ro and on city-owned hosts (gis.primaria*.ro, urbanism.*) that show PortalPublic UI and logo_fida.png. ArcGIS REST on webadaptor.gisapp.ro stays arcgisserver. Distinct from Kaliopa iObčina (iobcina) and from EQWC despite the shared gisapp path name.

name: dmCity
description: dmCity is Esri Finland's municipal digital-city SaaS. Public map tenants live at web.dmcity.fi/{city}/public/ with title dmCity Web App and jimu-core/init.js (Experience Builder shell). Distinct from generic ArcGIS Experience Builder (experiencebuilder) on other hosts and from ArcGIS Server REST on {city}.dmcity.fi/server (arcgisserver). One record per public city tenant, not the marketing site.

PopGIS is a geospatial data portal platform used by Pacific institutions to publish and access maps, layers, and related geographic information through web mapping interfaces and interoperable geospatial services.
name: PopGIS
Exponare
description: Exponare is MapInfo / Pitney Bowes (now Precisely) municipal web GIS, the predecessor to Spectrum Spatial Analyst. Public sites use /exponare/RestPublicApplication.aspx, /exponare/PublicApplication.aspx, /exponare/publicinvoker.aspx, or a council mapping.aspx wrapper that still loads Exponare. Distinct from Spectrum Spatial Analyst (/connect/analyst/), IntraMaps, and ArcGIS Hub/REST on the same owner.

GC2 (GeoCloud 2) is an open-source spatial-data platform from MapCentia, often paired with the Vidi browser GIS client. It deploys PostGIS, MapServer or QGIS Server, MapCache, and Elasticsearch, and exposes layers through a SQL API, WMS, WFS, and WMTS. Danish municipalities commonly host tenants on mapcentia.com or gc2.io.
name: GC2
myCarta
description: myCarta WebMap is Aveki's municipal web GIS for Swedish kommuner. Public maps use title myCarta WebMap with meta "a client map application from Aveki AB", path /webmap/ or /mycartawebmap/, or older js/emap.js. Distinct from Hajk (hajk) on other Swedish karta.* hosts. Skip login-only myCarta GO and the Aveki marketing site.

name: MuniSight
description: MuniSight (Catalis GIS WebMap) is a Canadian municipal GIS SaaS. Public tenants live at web.munisight.com/{Tenant} and share Login.aspx, App_Themes/Catalis, and CloudFront JS 3.9.x. Distinct from MRF Web Map (mrf), GIS Cloud (giscloud), and generic Hexagon GeoMedia WebMap (geomediawebmap) Geospatial Portal paths. Do not register the marketing homepage. Staff login walls are still the same product.

name: eLiteGIS
description: eLiteGIS is a server-based platform for building geographic information system (GIS) solutions, GIS portals, and spatial data infrastructures. It provides REST API services compatible with ArcGIS Server protocols and is commonly used with CoGIS to support online and offline map workflows.

name: InGeo
description: InGeo (ГИС ИнГео) is a geospatial platform from CSI Integro for municipal and regional GIS. Desktop InGeo maintains topographic and urban-planning maps; InGeo-Web publishes general plans, land-use rules, and other spatial data as public geoportals.

name: Myeongji WebGIS
description: Myeongji WebGIS is the municipal living-information map platform of Myeongji Information Technology (명지정보기술), a Korean GIS company in Jeonju. Deployments share one OpenLayers 2 client codebase identified by /js/base/MapSave.js, /js/base/BaseMap.js, /js/base/SeeMap.js, and /js/base/mapsave/MapSaveTool.js, and carry titles like 생활지리정보시스템 or 생활공간정보안내시스템. The Iksan deployment credits 명지정보기술 in its footer. Do not infer the platform from a Korean "Life Map" title or the Korean public-sector /common/ web template alone; the shared base JS assets are required.

name: Visor Urbano
description: Visor Urbano is Guadalajara's municipal urban-management GIS, replicated across Mexican cities with Bloomberg Philanthropies support. Public tenants use visorurbano.{city}.gob.mx or {city}.visorurbano.com for cadastral lookup, land-use consultation, and business or construction licences. Distinct from unrelated Leaflet city visors that reuse the "Visor Urbano" label (for example visorguadalupe.com).

name: map.apps
description: map.apps is a commercial WebGIS application framework from con terra for building map viewers and geoportals on top of ArcGIS and OGC services. Public deployments are typically served from a /mapapps/ path.

name: IGO2
description: IGO2 (Open GIS Infrastructure 2.0) is an open-source web GIS initiated by the Quebec public administration. Deployments use an Angular application assembled from IGO2 libraries and JSON context configuration, commonly with WMS, WFS, WPS, and CSW services. Confirm the IGO2 title or IGO2 configuration rather than generic Angular or OpenLayers use.

name: Datacube Open Web Services
description: Datacube Open Web Services (datacube-ows) is an open-source OGC service layer for Open Data Cube deployments. It publishes multidimensional Earth observation datasets through standards-based WMS and WCS endpoints, enabling map visualization and raster data access for analysis workflows. It is maintained by the Open Data Cube community and is commonly used to expose Analysis Ready Data from national and regional datacube infrastructures.

name: geoportal.ch
description: geoportal.ch is a hosted Swiss cantonal geoportal platform. Public tenants share www.geoportal.ch/{canton} (for example ktzg, ktai, ktar) with a common map UI. Distinct from swisstopo mf-geoadmin3 (mfgeoadmin3).

name: GeoMedia WebMap
description: GeoMedia WebMap is Hexagon's (formerly Intergraph) web GIS server for publishing OGC web services and interactive map applications. Public deployments typically expose Geospatial Portal (or GeoMedia WebMap Publisher Portal) as the browser client, often under paths such as /geoportal01/, /cdngiportal/, /msip/Full.aspx, or /Online_Mapping/, with page fingerprints including Version/Build, Licensed to, Intergraph.WebSolutions, $GP, and WebClient.ashx configuration handlers.

name: Mapotip
description: Mapotip is a Czech municipal web map portal for cadastre, DTM, and pasports. Public tenants live at portal.mapotip.cz/{municipality} and load /map/index-*.js with HTML title Mapotip. Distinct from T-MAPY GISPLAN (gisplan), Geoportál GEPRO (gepro), and TopGis GisOnline (gisonline).

name: MapGuide
description: Autodesk MapGuide Open Source (and MapGuide Enterprise) Web GIS. Public Hungarian CityScape E-GOV viewers load /mapguide/{city}/internet.php or mapviewerphp/ajaxviewer.php. Fusion, OpenLayers, and Arkance/Twigis branding are common on city hosts. Distinct from EnviMAP (envimap) and from old ExtJS MapFish terinfo sites.

name: stac-server
description: stac-server is an open-source STAC API implementation for publishing and querying geospatial metadata and assets. It provides a REST API for STAC catalogs, collections, and item search to support interoperable discovery workflows.

name: NetGIS Server
description: NetGIS Server is a geographic data server from Netcad Yazılım A.Ş. for publishing spatial data as OGC WMS, WFS, WCS, and WMTS services and as web map applications. Version 7 is commonly deployed by Turkish municipalities under a /Netgis7 path, often with a KEOS city-guide viewer as the public UI.

name: mviewer
description: mviewer is an open-source thematic map viewer (OpenLayers and Bootstrap) developed for GéoBretagne and widely reused by French régions, départements, and communes. Applications are configured with XML (apps/*.xml); optional mviewerstudio generates those configs. Distinct from Lizmap and QWC2.

name: GIS Cloud
description: GIS Cloud is a hosted web GIS. Public municipal tenants live at {city}.giscloud.com and load assets.giscloud.com (compiled-smart.js, api.js). Distinct from generic Leaflet viewers and from MuniSight (login-only web.munisight.com). Do not register the marketing homepage or Map Editor login.

name: GisOnline
description: GisOnline is TopGis's municipal web map application. Public city tenants live at app.gisonline.cz/{city} and load app-*.min.js with title “Mapová aplikace GisOnline.cz” and TopGis copyright. Distinct from T-MAPY GISPLAN (gisplan) and Geoportál GEPRO (gepro).

name: Flood Intelligence Portal
description: The Flood Intelligence Portal is a cloud SaaS product developed by Water Technology and Hydrologic for Australian catchment authorities. Public tenants use my.floodreport.com.au/{authority}/ and embed separately configured Water Technology applications that visualize flood events and produce property-specific flood-risk reports.

OpenGeoportal is an open-source geoportal platform for discovering, previewing, and accessing geospatial datasets across institutions. It supports federated search and metadata-driven discovery workflows for spatial data infrastructures, with integrations for standards-based geospatial services and export formats used by academic and public-sector data portals.
name: OpenGeoPortal
SIT WebGis
description: SIT WebGis is SIT Servizi di Informazione Territoriale's municipal GIS. Public tenants live at webgis.sit-puglia.it/{comune}/ with title WebGis {Town} (AngularJS ng-app WebApp plus OpenLayers 3 core/lib/openlayers/js/ol.js) or SIT-{TOWN} (Angular CLI plus ol-attribution-hotfix.js). Distinct from Regione Puglia GeoNetwork on repertorio.sit.puglia.it, Lizmap, Spectrum Spatial Analyst, and GeneGIS PAGIS. Do not register the marketing homepage. Skip stale homepage slugs such as /mola and /potenza that 404.

owner.name: SIT Servizi di Informazione Territoriale Srl

name: Wis 2.0 Box
description: WIS2 in a Box (wis2box) is an open-source reference implementation of a WMO WIS2 node for publishing, discovering, and exchanging meteorological and related geospatial data using standards-based web services and messaging.

name: CubeWerx CubeSERV
description: CubeWerx CubeSERV (Stratos Geospatial Platform) is a commercial OGC server for WMS, WMTS, WFS, WCS, CSW, and OGC API. National and provincial SDIs expose it as /cubewerx/cubeserv or a CubeWerx catalogue. Register it when CubeSERV is the public catalog, not merely a backend behind another portal. Distinct from GeoServer (geoserver) and MapServer (mapserver).

name: Geopixel Cidades
description: Geopixel Cidades is a Brazilian municipal geointelligence SaaS (cadastre, IPTU, and public map catalog). Public geoportals use {city}.geoportal.geopixel.com.br, a shared Next.js shell that loads city config from /api/pages. Older tenants also appear at {city}.geopixel.com.br/geopixelcidades-{city}/. The geoportal hostname is a DNS wildcard — do not register a city from HTTP 200 alone.

name: INGRADA online
description: INGRADA online is Softplan Informatik's municipal web GIS. Public BürgerGIS tenants title the page INGRADA online {project}, load /mobile/message-channel.js, and embed Softplan.Ingrada.Mobile with ProductId=IngradaOnline (city host or ingradaweb.org/{city}/online). Distinct from VertiGIS WebOffice (weboffice), MapGuide (mapguide), and generic BürgerGIS landing pages.

name: ActiveMap GIS
description: ActiveMap GIS is a geoinformation platform from Gradoservice that combines web mapping, a desktop layer editor, and mobile apps. It supports map objects on thematic layers, task and work-order workflows, publishing data with access control, offline-capable mobile use, and integrations such as WMS and REST APIs (including Russian municipal portals).

Terria is an open-source geospatial web platform for building interactive map-based data portals. It supports catalog-driven data discovery, visualization of spatial and tabular datasets, and integration with external geospatial services.
name: Terria
Trimble Landfolio
description: Landfolio (formerly FlexiCadastre) is Spatial Dimension's mining and land cadastre platform, now part of Trimble. Public Cadastre Map Portals are often hosted on portals.landfolio.com country tenants. ArcGIS REST services on the same estate stay arcgisserver; this id is for the Landfolio map-portal UI.

name: Evrymap
description: Evrymap is a municipal map portal from Consortis Geospatial. Instances brand the viewer as Evrymap and publish urban-planning and land-use layers over MapServer using OGC WMS, WFS, WMTS, WCS, and CSW.

name: brain-GeoCMS
description: brain-GeoCMS is brain-SCC GmbH's municipal geoportal and CMS product. Public geoportals set meta generator to GeoCMS Version:… with a brain-SCC suffix and a site-root base href.

name: GeoNetwork
description: GeoNetwork is an open-source catalog for discovering and sharing geospatial data and services. It offers search, faceted browsing, metadata editing with ISO 19115/19139 and Dublin Core, publication workflows, harvesting (CSW, OAI-PMH, WFS, and more), OGC CSW and REST APIs, DCAT export, and an interactive map viewer (OpenLayers) for WMS, WMTS, and related services. It is a reference implementation for spatial data infrastructures and is stewarded as an OSGeo project.

name: G3W-SUITE
description: G3W-SUITE is an open-source QGIS WebGIS platform (Django G3W-ADMIN plus Vue/OpenLayers G3W-CLIENT) for publishing QGIS projects as public map catalogs and OGC services. Italian regions, metropolitan cities, parks, and municipalities use it as the public geoportal. Distinct from Lizmap (lizmap) and QWC2 (qwc2).

name: Farvater GIS OGD
description: Farvater GIS OGD is a regional urban-planning information system from Internet-Fregat. It supports GIS OGD document registries, interactive maps via the Farvater GISdoc editor, public portals, and integrations with national spatial-data and public-services platforms.

name: Origo
description: Origo is an open-source OpenLayers web GIS developed by Origosamverkan. Public municipal maps load origo.min.js, origo.js, or Origo configuration JSON, often as named kommun kartan viewers on karta.*.se hosts. Distinct from Hajk (hajk), myCarta (mycarta), and GeoServer backends on the same estate.

name: OVIE
description: OVIE (Oficina Virtual de Información Económica) is INEGI's municipal economic GIS template for IMPLAN and state sites. Public viewers share OpenLayers OL.js, Materialize, html2canvas, canvg, and jsPdf under /js/libs/. Distinct from Mapa Digital de México / MxSIG (mxsig), whose product page is inegi.org.mx/servicios/mxsig.html, and from generic OpenLayers copies. Do not set ovie from Mission Viejo geoviewer.io or hostnames that merely contain ovie.

name: Hexagon M.App Enterprise
description: Hexagon M.App Enterprise is a commercial geoportal and browser GIS for publishing apps, maps, and OGC services. Public portals often live under /Apps/ with Hexagon Geospatial WMS/WFS. Distinct from GeoMedia WebMap (geomediawebmap) and ERDAS APOLLO (erdasapollo).

name: Pozi
description: Pozi is an Australian-owned web GIS for local government (Groundtruth / Pozi). Public council tenants live at {council}.pozi.com with HTML title Pozi Web Map and a shared CloudFront SPA (assets/entry-app-*.js). Distinct from IntraMaps Public (intramaps), Exponare (exponare), and Spectrum Spatial Analyst (spectrumspatial). Do not register the marketing homepage.

name: GIS4U
description: GIS4U is the municipal web map portal platform of T-MAPY spol. s r.o. (Hradec Kralove, Czechia). Tenants run on municipal domains with Czech application routes under /mapa/ (for example /mapa/zakladni-aplikace/, /mapa/technicka-mapa/), a shared /theme/square/ asset theme, and a tmapy.cz credit; the vendor's own example portals live on cr.gis4u.cz. Do not identify GIS4U from a tmapy.cz link alone; the /mapa/ application routes plus the square theme are required because T-MAPY sells several distinct products.
capabilities: Municipal map portal with application catalogue

name: Alta Vefsjá
description: Alta Vefsjá is Alta ehf.'s OpenLayers municipal map viewer used for Icelandic planning and local geoportals. Tenants live under geo.alta.is/{tenant}/ and load altacode vefsja assets. The shared GeoServer root at geo.alta.is/geoserver stays software.id geoserver.

name: SIGimWeb
description: Indixio SIGim Web (SIGimWeb) is a Quebec municipal GIS viewer for assessment rolls, graphic matrices, cadastre, and zoning. Public tenants use title SIGimWeb, path /sigimweb/ or /sigim/, ExtJS, and /gomap_web/. Distinct from generic MapGuide (mapguide), GOnet, and JP Cadrin CIF. One record per public MRC or city tenant, not per municipality in the picker.

name: MapServer
description: MapServer is an open-source platform for publishing spatial data and interactive mapping applications through OGC web services. It serves WMS, WFS, WCS, and related protocols from mapfiles, and is widely used as geospatial service middleware in government and research geoportals.

name: Berry GIS
description: Berry GIS is the hosted municipal GIS of Berry ICT (BerryBath Solutions & Cutting Edge Technologies), an Accra-based ICT firm. Public property-identification viewers run on the vendor domain under gis.berryict.com/gis/gis/{assembly}/propertyidentification.php with a shared Leaflet client and per-assembly layers for streets, buildings, parcels, blocks, communities, and sub-metros. The vendor also supplies street addressing (Geo-Spatial Address Systems) and property-rate mapping for Ghanaian assemblies.

owner.name: BerryBath Solutions & Cutting Edge Technologies (Berry ICT)

name: ArcGIS StoryMaps
description: ArcGIS StoryMaps is Esri's web-based geospatial storytelling product for combining maps, scenes, multimedia, and narrative content. Current ArcGIS Online stories use storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/{item-id}; Enterprise deployments use equivalent story routes. Only classify a story as a catalog when it is the public interface to discover or explore data.

name: EWMAPA
description: EWMAPA is a GIS and geodesy platform used for cadastral, utility, and municipal spatial data management. It supports map publication and geospatial data sharing for local government and surveying workflows, including interoperability through common OGC-style service and exchange formats.

name: GT Map
description: GT Map is V&G's municipal spatial-information platform for South Korean public authorities. Public LifeMap deployments load the V&G SODA OpenLayers client from /resources/common/thirdparty/soda/soda.js, whose header identifies V&G and a SODA version. Tenant applications commonly expose a municipal layer catalog and WMS gateway under /gs-gate/.

name: ArcGIS Server
description: ArcGIS Server is Esri's on-premises and private-cloud GIS server for publishing maps, feature layers, imagery, and geoprocessing as web services. It provides REST and SOAP endpoints plus OGC interfaces (WMS, WFS, WCS), CSW catalog services, and integrates with ArcGIS Enterprise components such as Portal for ArcGIS for security, licensing, and content management in regulated and air-gapped environments.

name: Bulplan UNIMAP
description: Bulplan UNIMAP is a Bulgarian municipal integrated geoportal used for spatial-planning, property, and support-plan maps. Public tenants live at {municipality}.bulplan.eu.

name: Copernicus DHuS
description: The Data Hub System (DHuS) is ESA's open-source catalog and download platform for Copernicus Sentinel data. National hubs such as ESTHub expose the DHuS web UI at /dhus/. It is distinct from the ECMWF Copernicus Data Stores (CDS).

name: Terratwin
description: Terratwin is an ArcGIS-based digital-twin and geoportal platform for German municipalities and districts, developed with cities and Landkreise for urban planning and citizen participation. Public clients share an identical hashed Vite bundle set with ALKIS cadastral modules (alkis-*.js), run on a /terratwin/ or /m/hokis/ route of a county GDI subdomain, or appear as vendor-hosted tenants under *.terratwin.net (for example Landkreis Calw on lracw.terratwin.net). Do not confuse with the unrelated EU research project terratwin.eu.

name: ArcGIS Hub
description: ArcGIS Hub is Esri's cloud-based community engagement platform for sharing open data, maps, and initiatives. Organizations use it with ArcGIS Online to publish branded Hub sites, including custom-domain opendata-ui sites and ArcGIS Enterprise /portal/apps/sites/ deployments, curate datasets and teams, run goals and initiatives, and engage the public with low-code web experiences. It exposes content through ArcGIS Hub and ArcGIS Online REST APIs, DCAT feeds, and OGC API Records.

name: Sitowise Louhi
description: Louhi is Sitowise's municipal geospatial platform. Public karttapalvelu viewers use OpenLayers with Sitowise analytics (snoobi partner=stw) and shared /Scripts/integration/openlayers assets. Distinct from Trimble Locus IMS (trimblelocus), which some Louhi maps may cite as a data source.

name: DIGITAL TWIN CLOUD
description: DIGITAL TWIN CLOUD is EGIS Co., Ltd.'s 3D GIS digital-twin SaaS (XDWorld engine), also white-labeled by NEWLAYER. Public municipal clients keep an HTML comment title DIGITAL TWIN CLOUD - NEWLAYER, load assets/css/IDE.css, and often expose a city smart-map UI on a .go.kr host. Confirm that comment or an egiscloud.com/newlayer.egiscloud.com tenant; do not identify from a generic "digital twin" or "smart map" title.

name: Gharysh Geoportal Platform
description: Modern reusable geoportal application developed by Kazakhstan Gharysh Sapary for sectoral government information systems. Confirmed deployments include HydroGOV and Tabigat, which use the same bilingual Next.js application family and share multiple byte-identical application bundles while retaining separate builds, branding, domains, owners, and thematic data.

owner.name: JSC National Company Kazakhstan Gharysh Sapary

name: e-mapa.net
description: e-mapa.net is Geo-System's hosted municipal and county spatial information platform (SIP) used across Poland. Tenants live at {powiat}.e-mapa.net and load the shared Pandora viewer from polska.e-mapa.net. Distinct from GEOBID EWMAPA (ewmapa) on geoportal2.pl.

name: Trimble Locus IMS
description: Trimble Locus IMS is the public Internet Map Service viewer of Trimble Locus (formerly Tekla municipal GIS). Finnish cities publish karttapalvelu tenants under /IMS/ with ASP.NET MVC bundles imscore and tekla-mvc-common. Distinct from Turkish BelsisIMS (belsisims) and from Sitowise Louhi (louhi).

name: KAZGISA RGIS
description: KAZGISA RGIS is the Regional Geographic Information System used by Kazakhstani akimats for land, urban-planning, and public-service maps. Public open-contour viewers share an Angular SPA at `{host}/map/` with Leaflet 1.7.1 (`runtime.js`, `polyfills.js`, `vendor.js`, `main.js`). Distinct from Geonomics (geonomics) Vue/Mapbox portals, SmartMap (smartmap) `{district}.smartmap.kz` tenants, and VKOMAP (vkomap) `/vkomap/` Leaflet+Esri viewers. Use KAZGISA OpenLayers WebGIS (kazgisaopenlayers) for the older OpenLayers and Knockout stack represented by eatyrau.kz.

name: Avinet Adaptive
description: Avinet Adaptive (Webatlas) is a Norwegian thematic map platform from Avinet AS / Asplan Viak Digitale tjenester. Public atlases load ExtJS 4.2 and OpenLayers 2.13, often from a3.avinet.no, and expose WMS/WFS via wms.ashx / wfs.ashx. Distinct from ISY Map (isymap) and from ArcGIS Hub.

IsiGéo is a geospatial information system and geoportal platform for publishing, visualizing, and sharing geographic datasets, map layers, and related metadata through web interfaces and API-enabled services. Distinct from Isogeo (isogeo), the French GIS metadata SaaS.
name: IsiGéo

description: QGIS Web Client 2 (QWC2) is an open source web GIS framework for publishing interactive geoportals on top of QGIS projects and OGC services. It provides configurable map viewers, search, feature info, and integration through REST-based backend services.
name: QGIS Web Client 2 (QWC2)
HyG Mapgis
description: HyG Mapgis (Suite MapGIS) is an on-premises municipal and regional GIS viewer from H&G Consultores S.A.S (Medellín). Installs use /mapgis/mapa.jsp?aplicacion= or /mapgis9/mapa.jsp?aplicacion= over ArcGIS Server/Java, with footer text Desarrollado por HyG Consultores S.A.S. Distinct from Zondy Cyber MapGIS IGServer (mapgisigserver, /igs/rest/). Do not register a second ArcGIS Server catalog on the same Mapgis host, and do not add Mapgis as a second product on a host that already has GeoNetwork as the public catalog.

name: LocalMaps
description: LocalMaps is Eagle Technology's New Zealand council web GIS, built on ArcGIS, with a public gallery and Web AppBuilder viewer. Tenants use /localmaps/gallery or a council-branded /{Name}Maps/Gallery/ path and title LocalMaps Gallery. Distinct from ArcGIS Server REST directories on the same host, IntraMaps, Geocortex, and generic Experience Builder apps.

name: DATUM GIS
description: DATUM GIS is a web geoinformation platform from DATUM Soft for publishing, editing, and analyzing spatial data in regional and municipal GIS portals. It supports map visualization, object cards with attached documents, metadata search, import and export, geocoding, and modular extensions. The product is listed in the Russian software registry and is used for regional SDI and GIS OGD deployments.

Open Data Cube is an open-source platform for indexing, managing, and analyzing large spatiotemporal Earth observation datasets. It provides a Python-centric data cube model and API for scalable analytics, and is commonly integrated with STAC-compatible metadata services in national and regional geospatial data infrastructures.
name: Open Data Cube
Geonomics
description: Geonomics is a regional geoportal platform for collecting, storing, visualizing, and analyzing spatial data. Deployments share a Vue SSR and Express web application with Mapbox GL maps, collection APIs, EDS login, and optional GeoServer backends. It is used by Kazakhstani akimats for land, urban-planning, and administrative-territorial layers.

name: BelsisIMS
description: BelsisIMS is the Internet Map Server suite from Belsis. The public city-guide module is KRH (Kent Rehber Haritası), typically at ims.{municipality}.bel.tr/Projects/{NAME}/Pages/KRH.aspx. It is a different product from Netcad Netigma and from NetGIS Server / KEOS.

name: ArcGIS Web AppBuilder
description: ArcGIS Web AppBuilder (Web AppViewer) is Esri's earlier configurable map app, typically at /apps/webappviewer/index.html?id= on ArcGIS Online or Portal for ArcGIS. Exported self-hosted builds retain the Jimu client and load env.js, simpleLoader.js, init.js, and jimu.js. Distinct from ArcGIS Experience Builder (experiencebuilder), ArcGIS Instant Apps (instantapps), ArcGIS Hub (arcgishub), and ArcGIS Server REST directories (arcgisserver). Esri is retiring Web AppBuilder in favor of Experience Builder.

name: GEUSMAP
description: GEUSMAP is the Geological Survey of Denmark and Greenland map application. Named databases (Jupiter, GERDA, Greenland Mineral Resources) share /geusmap/?mapname= with public WMS/WFS export. One record per public mapname, not per layer.

owner.name: Geological Survey of Denmark and Greenland (GEUS)

description: pygeoapi is an open source Python server implementation of OGC API standards for publishing and querying geospatial data. It provides RESTful access to vector, raster, and record collections with support for multiple OGC interfaces.
name: pygeoapi
cardo
description: cardo is a geospatial application platform from IDU IT for managing, publishing, and viewing geodata, metadata, and related records in public-sector geoportals. Public internet deployments commonly use the cardo.Map / net3 web stack (paths such as /net3/public/).

name: AddSpatial
description: AddSpatial is Icebound's web GIS platform (formerly Sokigo GLS). Public municipal clients use title AddSpatial, path /smart/?profile=, LoginService/Brands, and images/addspatial.svg, often wrapped from a karta.* host that iframes atlas.{kommun}.se/smart/. Distinct from Hajk (hajk), Origo (origo), myCarta (mycarta), and Digpro dpWebmap (dpwebmap). Skip the vendor cloud login at addspatial.icebound.com/SMART and Icebound marketing pages.

name: Dobles Visor de Mapas
description: Packaged Costa Rican municipal Leaflet cadastral viewer used by independent cantons. Public apps share /comun/jquery-ui-1.12.1/, /comun/js/leaflet.js, and /comun/js/Leaflet.GoogleMutant.js, often with title Visor de Mapas. Pococí credits Leonardo Dobles. Distinct from ArcGIS Experience Builder visors and from MapStore or GeoNetwork on other CR hosts.

name: InGrid
description: InGrid is an open-source metadata and geoportal platform used for German environmental and spatial-data infrastructures. It provides a searchable catalog, CSW and OpenSearch interfaces, and a map client, and is the software behind portals such as MetaVer.

name: VertiGIS Studio Web
description: VertiGIS Studio Web (formerly Geocortex Web / GXW) is a commercial web GIS viewer on Esri ArcGIS. Public apps launch from /vertigisstudio/web/?app={guid}, /gcx/WebViewer/?app={guid}, or /Geocortex/WebViewer/?app={guid}, with HTML #gcx-app and a page title VertiGIS Studio Web. SaaS tenants appear under apps.vertigisstudio.com and apps.vertigisstudio.eu. Distinct from Geocortex Essentials (geocortex) Html5Viewer / REST Sites Directory and from VertiGIS WebOffice (weboffice). One catalog per public tenant, not per app GUID.

name: p.mapper
description: p.mapper is an open-source PHP/MapScript web GIS frontend for MapServer. Public catalogs use a /pmapper/ or /pmapper-4.2.0/ path (Calabria SETIN tenants on {city}.geo-portale.it) or title p.mapper. Distinct from UMN MapServer as the public catalog (mapserver), Lizmap (lizmap), and Mapbender (mapbender). Do not add a second mapserver record on the same p.mapper UI.

name: CoGIS
description: CoGIS is a geospatial infrastructure platform from Data East for publishing interactive maps, map applications, and geoportals. The public catalog is CoGIS Portal; map services may be served by CoGIS Server, eLiteGIS, or ArcGIS Server. CoGIS Mobile and Designer complete the stack.

name: GIS4Smart
description: GIS4Smart is a municipal spatial data infrastructure product from DOTSOFT (Smartiscity). Instances are hosted on gis4smart.city or customer domains and brand the viewer as Y.Ge.P. / DotSpatial. That on-page name is unrelated to the OSGeo DotSpatial .NET library.

name: GeoViewer Online
description: GeoViewer Online is Nobel Systems' cloud GIS and operations platform. Public-view deployments use customer subdomains on geoviewer.io and load Nobel-branded styles from geoviewer.io. The wider product combines maps with asset, work-order, reporting, SCADA, and IoT functions.

name: Georeal
description: Georeal is GEOREAL's OrchardCore CMS for Czech kraj DTM and geoportal sites. Public tenants live at {dtm|geoportal}.{kraj}.cz/portal/ and load /portal/Georeal.Cards/Apps/card-container.min.js (often with Georeal.UzemniPlanovani and an IsDTMKraj* theme). Distinct from T-MAPY GISPLAN (gisplan), Geoportál GEPRO (gepro), and GEOVAP Marushka (marushka).

name: SuperMap iPortal
description: SuperMap iPortal is SuperMap's GIS portal product for integrating, searching, sharing, and managing geospatial resources. It is the user-facing catalog and application hub that registers services from SuperMap iServer and other OGC or REST sources, distinct from the iServer GIS engine.

name: MRF Web Map
description: MRF Web Map is MRF Geosystems' municipal GIS platform used by prairie local governments. Public tenants live at {county}.mrf.com or city hosts that load js/lib/mrf/ and title MRF Web Disclaimer. Distinct from GIS Cloud (giscloud) and from MuniSight/Catalis login portals (web.munisight.com). Do not register the marketing homepage or staff-only modules.

Fusion Metadata Registry (FMR) is the SDMX structural metadata registry published under the BIS Open Tech initiative (sdmx.io). It stores dataflows, DSDs, and codelists and exposes the SDMX REST API used by official-statistics registries.

owner.name: Bank for International Settlements (BIS Open Tech)

name: Fusion Metadata Registry

description: FAIR Data Point is an open-source REST API and web client for creating, storing, and serving FAIR metadata as RDF following DCAT and the FAIR Data Point specification. Installations publish catalogs, datasets, and distributions, and can optionally register with a FAIR Data Point Index.
name: FAIR Data Point

description: Aristotle Metadata Registry is an open-source metadata registry platform for authoring, managing, and publishing structured metadata models and controlled vocabularies through a web interface and API-driven workflows.
name: Aristotle Metadata Registry
Metadata Browser
description: Metadata Browser is a metadata catalog and discovery interface from MetadataWorks, designed to help organizations publish and explore datasets, standards, and terminologies with configurable search and federated visibility features.

name: DataHub
description: LinkedIn/Acryl DataHub is an open-source metadata platform for the modern data stack. Public catalog UIs title DataHub, describe themselves as a metadata platform, and expose GraphQL at `/api/graphql` (often authenticated). Distinct from datahub.io (CKAN).

name: CEDAR Workbench
description: CEDAR Workbench is Stanford's open-source Center for Expanded Data Annotation and Retrieval stack. It publishes reusable metadata templates and filled metadata instances for biomedical experiments. Register the public workbench, not each template or the metadatacenter.org marketing site.

owner.name: Stanford Center for Biomedical Informatics Research

name: WormBase
description: WormBase is the C. elegans and nematode model-organism knowledgebase, publishing genomes, genes, and related datasets (Alliance of Genome Resources).

name: LOVD
description: Leiden Open Variation Database is a reusable open-source platform for curating and publishing gene-centered DNA variant databases. Independent installations manage genes, variants and associated individual-level data with configurable access.

name: NYU Data Catalog
description: NYU Data Catalog is an open-source catalog for describing and discovering research datasets held inside an institution or referenced from external sources. Medical-library deployments share one frontend for dataset records, local experts, and schema.org DataCatalog markup. It is used by NYU Langone and other health-sciences libraries.

name: META-SHARE
description: META-SHARE is the META-NET language-resource exchange facility. National and project nodes share a common repository UI for corpora, lexica, tools, and related language datasets.

GBIF Platform is the data infrastructure of the Global Biodiversity Information Facility, providing access to species occurrence records, taxonomic backbones, and metadata from biodiversity publishers worldwide through web search, APIs, and downloadable data packages.
name: GBIF Platform

description: Worktribe is a commercial research management and repository platform used by universities and research organizations to manage grants, publications, impact, and research data workflows.
name: Worktribe
Australian Ocean Data Network (AODN) Portal
description: The Australian Ocean Data Network (AODN) Portal is a marine and climate data discovery platform that provides search, map-based exploration, API access, and download workflows for ocean observations and related environmental datasets.

owner.name: Australian Ocean Data Network (AODN), Integrated Marine Observing System (IMOS)

name: MetaboLights
description: MetaboLights is EMBL-EBI's cross-species metabolomics repository for studies, metabolites, and associated ISA-tab metadata, with a public REST API.
Elsevier Digital Commons is a hosted institutional repository platform for publishing, preserving, and showcasing scholarly outputs, research data, and related academic content.
name: Elsevier Digital Commons
SciCat
description: SciCat is an open-source metadata catalogue for large scientific facilities. It stores dataset metadata, persistent identifiers, and publication workflows for photon, neutron, and similar instruments. The Angular frontend and companion DOI landing pages are used at PSI, ESS, MAX IV, and other labs.

Galaxy is an open-source web-based platform for accessible, reproducible, and transparent computational biomedical research, supporting data analysis workflows, tool integration, and collaborative science.
name: Galaxy

description: Figshare is a cloud-based repository platform for publishing, preserving, discovering, and sharing research outputs with persistent identifiers, citation support, and institutional repository workflows.
name: Figshare
Axiom Data Science Portal
description: Axiom Data Science Portal is a hosted ocean-observing data explorer used by IOOS regional associations. Deployments share the same XHTML portal chrome with interactive maps, sensor time series, and compiled data views. It is distinct from ERDDAP and THREDDS backends that often sit behind the same regional associations.
Haplo is a research information management and repository platform used by universities and research organizations to manage, publish, and discover research outputs and related metadata.
name: Haplo
ProteoSAFe
description: ProteoSAFe is UCSD CCMS's mass-spectrometry workflow and dataset catalog platform. GNPS metabolomics and MassIVE proteomics share the ProteoSAFe UI (`/ProteoSAFe/datasets.jsp`) and public dataset APIs.

owner.name: Center for Computational Mass Spectrometry, UC San Diego

description: OPUS 4 is open-source institutional repository software for publishing, managing, and harvesting scholarly documents and research data. It is developed by the Cooperative Library Network Berlin-Brandenburg (KOBV) and supports OAI-PMH, URN and DOI assignment, and a dedicated Research Data document type.
name: OPUS
TemplateFlow
description: TemplateFlow is the NiPreps archive of FAIR neuroimaging templates and atlases. The public catalog is the archive browser at templateflow.org; the DataLad super-dataset and Python client are access layers, not extra catalogs. Register the hub, not each template repository.

name: dLibra
description: dLibra is a digital library and repository platform used by libraries, archives, and research organizations to publish, describe, and provide access to scientific and cultural collections through web interfaces and metadata harvesting.

name: OpenKIM
description: OpenKIM (Open Knowledgebase of Interatomic Models) is an open-source repository of interatomic potentials and force fields for atomistic simulation, with verification tests and a query API for models and tests.

name: openEQUELLA
description: Reusable digital repository for educational and research content, with configurable collections, metadata, versioning, search, access control, OAI-PMH harvesting and REST APIs.

DABAR (Digital Academic Archives and Repositories) is Croatia’s national multi-tenant institutional repository platform, operated by the University of Zagreb University Computing Centre (SRCE). Public tenants expose a shared Laravel UI and OAI-PMH, with Fedora as the storage layer after the 2025 reimplementation (previously Drupal and Islandora). Register one catalog per public institutional hostname, not each namespace facet on the national hub.

owner.name: University of Zagreb, University Computing Centre (SRCE)

name: DABAR

description: DSpace is an open source repository platform for managing, preserving, and sharing scholarly and scientific digital assets with support for institutional repositories and long-term access.
name: DSpace

description: LibreCat is an open-source publication and research information repository platform developed by a community of library technologists for managing, enriching, and publishing scholarly metadata and records.
name: LibreCat
HUBzero
description: HUBzero is an open-source software platform for building science and engineering gateways and collaborative research portals with tools for data sharing, publishing, and community engagement.

Pure is Elsevier's research information management platform for institutions to manage profiles, publications, datasets, and reporting workflows, with support for discovery and interoperability via standard metadata protocols.
name: Pure
TalkBank
description: TalkBank is the shared web application for spoken-language transcript banks. Independent collections such as CHILDES, AphasiaBank, and FluencyBank run on *.talkbank.org with the CHAT format, a common browser, and bulk corpus downloads.

name: DaCHS
description: The GAVO Data Center Helper Suite publishes astronomical data through Virtual Observatory services. It combines data ingestion, metadata mapping, a publishing registry, table queries and web interfaces.

name: UCSC Genome Browser
description: The UCSC Genome Browser is the University of California Santa Cruz genome annotation catalog and viewer, with public track hubs, REST/GBIB APIs, and bulk downloads.

name: GIN
description: GIN (G-Node Infrastructure) is a git-annex repository platform for versioned scientific datasets, based on a Gogs fork. It is used for neuroscience and related experimental data, with DOI landing pages for published repositories.

name: Yoda
description: Yoda (Your Data) is an open-source research data management platform developed by Utrecht University and the Dutch Yoda Consortium, hosted by SURF. It sits on iRODS for storage and collaboration, then publishes FAIR datasets with DataCite DOIs from institutional vaults and public landing pages.

name: Specify Web Portal
description: Public biodiversity collection portal distributed by the Specify Collections Consortium. Publishes exported Specify collections through configurable specimen, image and map views backed by Solr.

name: PlutoF
description: PlutoF is the University of Tartu biodiversity data workbench and repository. It publishes taxonomical, ecological, and molecular datasets with a public REST API and DOI landing pages used by UNITE and other biodiversity projects.

owner.name: University of Tartu Natural History Museum and Botanical Garden

name: Greenstone Digital Library Software
description: Greenstone is an open-source system for building, organizing, searching, and publishing digital library collections. Greenstone 3 installations have distinctive /greenstone3/{library}/collection routes and can expose collection metadata through an integrated OAI-PMH server.

owner.name: New Zealand Digital Library Project, University of Waikato

description: Omega-PSIR is a university research information system that combines CRIS, institutional repository, researcher profiling, and research data repository capabilities in one platform.

owner.name: Institute of Computer Science, Warsaw University of Technology

name: Omega-PSIR
FAIRDOM-SEEK
description: FAIRDOM-SEEK is an open-source catalog for describing, sharing, and publishing scientific assets including datasets, models, SOPs, and computational workflows. Rails deployments such as WorkflowHub and FAIRDOMHub expose a JSON API and support CWL, RO-Crate, and related FAIR interchange formats.

name: Kadi4Mat
description: Kadi4Mat is KIT's open research data infrastructure for materials science. It publishes records, collections, and files through a web UI and REST API and is used as a Kadi instance for NFDI-MatWerk and related labs.

name: Synapse
description: Synapse is Sage Bionetworks' hosted platform for sharing biomedical research files, tables, and project catalogs. Disease portals such as the AD Knowledge Portal and NF Data Portal are Synapse tenants with a shared REST API.

name: JGI Genome Portal
description: The DOE Joint Genome Institute Genome Portal family (including MycoCosm, PhycoCosm, and Phytozome) publishes genome, transcriptome, and related comparative datasets through a shared JGI portal stack and download workspace.
LinkAhead is an open-source research data management software toolkit that helps institutions and research teams integrate, organize, and publish FAIR research data across heterogeneous systems.
name: IndiScale LinkAhead
ESIMO
description: ESIMO is Russia's federated information infrastructure for World Ocean data. Its central and regional portal nodes publish shared marine and hydrometeorological metadata catalogs, distributed data resources, maps and data services through a common portal and integration architecture.

DSpace CRIS is an open-source research information and data repository platform built on DSpace, designed to manage publications, datasets, projects, people, and institutional research outputs with interoperability and persistent identifiers.
name: DSpace CRIS
GRIN-Global
description: GRIN-Global is the open-source genebank information system used by USDA NPGS, Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada, and other plant genetic-resource centres. Installations publish accessions, taxonomy, and related germplasm data through a shared /gringlobal/ web application.

owner.name: USDA Agricultural Research Service / Crop Trust

name: CLLD
description: Cross-Linguistic Linked Data (CLLD) is the shared web application for comparative linguistics databases. Installations such as Grambank, Lexibank, and Pofatu run on *.clld.org with clld-static assets and publish parameter/language catalogs plus bulk downloads.

owner.name: Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology

name: MassBank
description: MassBank is an open community database of reference mass spectra. Independent instances (MassBank Europe, MassBank Japan, MassBank of North America / MoNA) share the MassBank-web software for searching, depositing, and exporting spectral records.

name: BEXIS2
description: BEXIS2 is an open-source research data management and repository platform for structured and unstructured data. It supports configurable metadata, dataset versioning, variable-level data structures, access control, search, DOI workflows, downloads, and read/write web APIs.

owner.name: BEXIS2 Team, Friedrich Schiller University Jena

name: Ensembl
description: Ensembl is EMBL-EBI's genome browser and comparative genomics platform. Taxon-specific portals such as Ensembl Fungi, Protists, and Metazoa share annotation tools, REST APIs, and bulk sequence and metadata downloads.

name: cBioPortal
description: cBioPortal is an open-source cancer genomics data portal from Memorial Sloan Kettering and the cBioPortal community. Public and institutional instances share a study catalog, mutation/CNA views, and a documented REST API.

owner.name: Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center / cBioPortal community

name: Collection Workflow Integration System
description: The Collection Workflow Integration System (CWIS) is open-source software for assembling, organizing, searching, and sharing metadata collections. It provides configurable schemas, qualified Dublin Core, RSS and metadata exports, and an integrated OAI-PMH server with selective harvesting.

owner.name: Internet Scout Research Group, University of Wisconsin-Madison

name: Breedbase
description: Breedbase is an open-source breeding information system from the Sol Genomics Network / Boyce Thompson Institute. Crop instances (CassavaBase, MusaBase, YamBase, SweetPotatoBase, T3, and others) publish trials, phenotypes, genotypes, and related genomic data, typically with a BrAPI interface.

owner.name: Boyce Thompson Institute / Sol Genomics Network

description: OpenML is an open machine learning platform and repository for sharing, discovering, and reusing datasets, tasks, flows, and experiment results.
name: OpenML
InterMine
description: InterMine is an open-source biological data warehouse. Organism and project mines (FlyMine, HumanMine, WheatMine, and others) share a query UI, list tools, and a versioned REST web service for genes, experiments, and related datasets.

name: Wikibase
description: Wikibase is the open-source knowledge-base software that runs Wikidata. Instances expose MediaWiki, a Wikibase API, and typically a SPARQL endpoint.

name: Diversity Workbench
description: Diversity Workbench is an open-source modular research environment for managing and publishing bio- and geodiversity data. Its database modules cover collections, observations, taxonomies, descriptions, projects, and agents, with publication pipelines for BioCASe/ABCD, RDF, and other exports.

owner.name: SNSB IT Center and University of Bayreuth

description: Archipelago Commons is an open-source digital objects repository and DAM architecture built on Drupal. Metadata lives as JSON in Strawberryfield; public catalogs expose Archipelago Digital Objects (ADOs) via Solr search, IIIF, optional OAI-PMH, and Drupal JSON:API. Installations range from GLAM collections to germplasm and research-data catalogs.
name: Archipelago Commons
NMRShiftDB2
description: NMRShiftDB2 is an open-source NMR database application for organic structures and assigned spectra. Independent laboratory instances can be installed from the published WAR and source; the Cologne public database is the reference catalog. A REST interface is documented at /api-docs/.
Esploro is a research information management and repository platform by Ex Libris for showcasing, managing, and disseminating institutional research outputs, including publications and datasets.
name: Esploro

description: OPeNDAP Hyrax is the OPeNDAP 4 data server, combining the OLFS web front end and BES back end to publish scientific array and tabular data through DAP2, DAP4, and directory-style catalogs. It is unrelated to Samvera Hyrax.
name: OPeNDAP Hyrax
Codabench
description: Codabench is the open-source successor to CodaLab Competitions. It publishes a public catalog of benchmarks, competitions, and datasets. Title Codabench. Use software.id codalab for the older competitions.codalab.org hub.

name: PHAIDRA
description: PHAIDRA (Permanent Hosting, Archiving and Indexing of Digital Resources and Assets) is open-source institutional repository software developed at the University of Vienna. It provides long-term preservation, metadata management, and access for research data, publications, and cultural heritage, with OAI-PMH and a REST API.

RAMADDA (Repository for Archiving, Managing and Accessing Diverse Data) is an open-source data repository platform for publishing, searching, and serving scientific datasets with metadata and API access.
name: RAMADDA

description: InstDB is the institutional research data repository component of the FairStack suite (Chinese Academy of Sciences / CNIC). It supports publication review, discovery, access, and user services for openly published scientific data; standardized service interfaces for interoperability; and assigns persistent identifiers including DOI and CSTR. It integrates with the DataSpace collaboration tool for team workflows and is aimed at FAIR-oriented scientific data centers.

owner.name: Computer Network Information Center, Chinese Academy of Sciences

name: InstDB
OMERO
description: OMERO is the Open Microscopy Environment server for managing, viewing, and publishing microscopy images and related experimental metadata. Public archives such as the Image Data Resource (IDR) are OMERO deployments with a JSON API.

name: Nextstrain
description: Nextstrain is an open-source project for pathogen genome phylodynamics. The nextstrain.org hub and community instances share Auspice visualizations, a dataset catalog, and documented JSON/narrative APIs for outbreak analyses.

owner.name: Nextstrain project (University of Basel / Fred Hutch)

description: WEKO3 is an open-source institutional repository platform for managing, publishing, and preserving scientific outputs and datasets with configurable metadata workflows.

owner.name: Research Center for Open Science and Data Platform (RCOS), National Institute of Informatics

name: WEKO3
ESGF
description: Earth System Grid Federation search and index software (Metagrid and esg-search) used by climate-model archives such as CMIP. Use this id for public ESGF search/index portals. ESGF data nodes that expose THREDDS catalogs should use software.id thredds instead.

owner.name: Earth System Grid Federation / Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory

name: WikiPathways
description: WikiPathways is the open community pathway database. Pathways are editable wiki pages with a REST API and bulk GPML/RDF exports.

name: CyVerse Data Commons
description: CyVerse Data Commons is the public data-publication catalog of the CyVerse cyberinfrastructure. Curated DOI datasets and community-released collections are discoverable through the Data Commons UI, with iRODS storage underneath.

name: easydb
description: easydb is Programmfabrik's web collection and research-data catalog (easydb 5, with fylr as the successor). Public tenants title the client easydb 5, inject fylr_inject / window.easydb_base_prefix, and expose /api/v1/session.

name: Aubrey
description: UNT Libraries digital collection access platform, deployed as separate branded instances for the UNT Digital Library, Portal to Texas History and Gateway to Oklahoma History. Provides resource discovery, descriptive metadata and public metadata interfaces.

SEANOE (SEA scieNtific Open data Edition) is IFREMER's scientific data repository and publishing platform for oceanographic and environmental datasets, providing long-term access, metadata indexing, and DOI assignment workflows.
name: IFREMER Catalog
BioStudies
description: BioStudies is EMBL-EBI's archive for biological studies and associated data files that do not fit a dedicated archive, with a public search API.

name: Grand Challenge
description: Grand Challenge is an Apache-2.0 Django platform for biomedical-imaging archives, reader studies, challenges, and algorithms. The public hub is grand-challenge.org. Register that hub, not each challenge, archive, or algorithm. Independent sites can be installed from the published source.

OpenScience.si repository software is the shared institutional-repository stack developed at the University of Maribor Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science for the Slovenian open-access infrastructure. University and research-organisation tenants (DKUM, RUL, RUP, RUNG, ReVIS, DiRROS) share one PHP application with OAI-PMH at /oai/oai2.php. It is not DSpace, EPrints, or Fedora. The national openscience.si portal is an aggregator over those tenants, not a third-party product.

owner.name: University of Maribor, Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science

name: OpenScience.si repository
MGnify
description: MGnify (formerly EBI Metagenomics) is EMBL-EBI's open archive and analysis platform for microbiome-derived nucleotide datasets, with a public REST API.

name: Gen3
description: Gen3 is the open-source data commons platform from the University of Chicago Center for Translational Data Science. Portals share a React data-portal UI, Fence authentication, Indexd/DRS object indexing, and GraphQL/Peregrine query APIs.

owner.name: Center for Translational Data Science, University of Chicago

name: Converis
description: Converis is a commercial current research information system (CRIS) used by universities and research organizations to manage research profiles, outputs, projects, grants, and reporting workflows in a centralized platform.

name: Tripal
description: Tripal is an open-source toolkit for constructing online biological databases. It is a Drupal module suite on the GMOD Chado schema, used by community genome databases (CottonGEN, SoyBase, PeanutBase, GDR, TreeGenes, and others) to publish genes, maps, germplasm, and related datasets.

Fedora Repository is an open-source, standards-based preservation repository that stores digital objects and RDF metadata behind a REST Linked Data Platform API. It is used as a backend for research-data and cultural-heritage catalogs, often with a custom, Islandora, Hyrax, or PHAIDRA public interface.
name: Fedora Repository
JACQ
description: JACQ is an open-source jointly administered herbarium management system and specimen database. Participating herbaria publish collections through the shared Virtual Herbaria portal, with REST services at api.jacq.org. Register the public portal, not each Index Herbariorum acronym on the same server.

name: Hugging Face
description: Hugging Face Hub is the public catalog of ML datasets (and models) at huggingface.co. The datasets library and Hub API are open source; register the datasets catalog once, not per-user spaces.
OntoPortal is an open-source ontology repository platform for publishing, browsing, annotating, and accessing biomedical and domain ontologies through web interfaces and REST APIs.

owner.name: Stanford Center for Biomedical Informatics Research

name: OntoPortal

description: InvenioRDM is an open source research data repository platform for publishing, curating, and sharing datasets with configurable metadata, persistent identifiers, access control, and interoperability features for institutional and domain repositories.
name: InvenioRDM

description: PyDAP is an open-source Python implementation of the OPeNDAP Data Access Protocol, used to publish and access scientific datasets with remote subsetting and variable-level retrieval over HTTP.
name: PyDAP
Pathway Tools
description: Pathway Tools is SRI International’s software for Pathway/Genome Databases. BioCyc family sites (EcoCyc, MetaCyc, YeastCyc, and the BioCyc collection) share the Pathway Tools web UI for genomes, metabolic pathways, and related datasets.

name: CodaLab Competitions
description: CodaLab Competitions is an open-source machine-learning competition platform with a public catalog of competitions and associated datasets. The successor product Codabench uses software.id codabench.

name: MOLGENIS
description: MOLGENIS is an open-source FAIR scientific data platform for configurable databases, catalogues, biobank directories, and research registries. The current EMX2 generation provides GraphQL, CSV, Excel, and linked-data interfaces; older installations can use the distinctive molgenis.do application route.

owner.name: Genomics Coordination Center, University Medical Center Groningen

capabilities: FAIR Data Point and DCAT support

name: Materials Cloud
description: Materials Cloud is an open science platform for computational materials science built around AiiDA. Explore and Archive publish curated work graphs, records, and DOI datasets with REST access for entries and files.

owner.name: École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne / MARVEL NCCR

name: OpenAlex
description: OpenAlex is OurResearch's open bibliographic catalog of works, authors, institutions, venues, and funders, with a public REST API and snapshot dumps.

VuFind is an open-source discovery platform used by libraries to index and search catalogs, digital repositories, and research outputs through a unified interface with faceted search and API-based integrations.
name: VuFind
iNaturalist
description: iNaturalist is the open-source citizen-science platform for organism observations. Register the public hub (and documented independent iNaturalist network nodes), not per-user observation feeds.

owner.name: California Academy of Sciences / National Geographic Society

name: DataLad
description: DataLad is an open source data management and distribution framework built on Git and git-annex, used in scientific workflows to version datasets, track provenance, and automate reproducible data access across local and remote storage.

name: Chemotion Repository
description: Chemotion Repository is the AGPL catalog for samples, reactions, and analytical chemistry data (NMR, IR, UV-Vis, MS) developed at KIT for NFDI4Chem. It is distinct from Chemotion ELN, which is the laboratory notebook rather than the public dataset catalog. Docker deployments are documented for independent institutional repositories.

BirdMap Africa is the shared citizen-science atlas platform of the African Bird Atlas Project (FitzPatrick Institute of African Ornithology). Country projects (SABAP2, Nigeria, Kenya, Senegal, and others) publish pentad-based bird distribution catalogs on {project}.birdmap.africa with a public REST API at api.birdmap.africa. Distinct from the BirdLasser mobile app used to submit cards.

owner.name: FitzPatrick Institute of African Ornithology, University of Cape Town

name: BirdMap Africa
Korp
description: Korp is Språkbanken Text's open-source corpus search platform (MIT). Independent national language-bank installations in Sweden, Finland, Estonia, Norway, Denmark, and Iceland share the Korp frontend, Python backend, and Corpus Workbench. Register each public Korp UI, not every corpus inside one instance.

name: Dialnet CRIS
description: Fundacion Dialnet hosted research information platform for institutional research portals. Integrates researcher profiles, research outputs, projects and organizational structures, with export services and bibliographic indicators.

Hyrax is an open-source repository front-end framework in the Samvera ecosystem for publishing, managing, and preserving research outputs and related digital objects with configurable metadata workflows. It is unrelated to the OPeNDAP Hyrax data server.
name: Samvera Hyrax
Open Context
description: Open Context is the Alexandria Archive Institute's open-source publisher of archaeological and related research data. The public hub at opencontext.org assigns DOIs and rich context to datasets, images, maps, and field notes. Register the hub, not each project or media item.

Omeka S is an open-source web publishing platform for cultural heritage and research collections. It exposes items as JSON-LD through a REST API, supports Dublin Core and linked-data vocabularies, and can publish dataset catalogs via modules such as Linked Data Sets and OAI-PMH Repository.
name: Omeka S
VIVO
description: VIVO is an open-source semantic web platform for research discovery. It indexes and links people, organizations, projects, facilities, funding, scholarly works, datasets, and other research entities using RDF ontologies, faceted search, SPARQL, and data-distribution APIs.

name: IBDC
description: Indian Biological Data Centre (IBDC) is the national biological data platform operated with the Department of Biotechnology. Domain archives (INDA, IPD, IMDA, IADA, IBIA, IPR, ISDA, GenomeIndia, ICPD, and related) share the ibdc.dbt.gov.in host and accession UI.

name: Brainlife
description: Brainlife is an open-source neuroimaging cloud (MRI, EEG, MEG) with processing apps and provenance tracking. First-party docs describe it as a single public SaaS hub at brainlife.io, not software to install at each institution. Register that hub, not each dataset, app, publication, or HPC resource registered into it.

name: Open Science Framework
description: Open Science Framework (OSF) is a hosted research collaboration and repository platform from the Center for Open Science. It stores projects, files, registrations, and preprints with DOIs and a public JSON:API. Institutions can brand OSF instances while sharing the same core software.
Dataverse is an open-source research data repository platform for publishing, sharing, citing, exploring, and reusing research datasets with rich metadata, versioning, and persistent identifiers.

owner.name: The President and Fellows of Harvard College

name: Dataverse

description: THREDDS Data Server (TDS) is an open-source web server for cataloging, accessing, and subsetting scientific datasets via OPeNDAP and OGC web services.
name: Thredds
e!DAL
description: e!DAL (electronic Data Archive Library) is IPK Gatersleben's open research-data infrastructure. The core archive and domain stores such as e!DAL-PGP publish versioned datasets with DOIs and a documented API.

owner.name: Leibniz Institute of Plant Genetics and Crop Plant Research (IPK)

name: DANDI Archive
description: DANDI is an open archive for neurophysiology and related cellular datasets using NWB, BIDS, and NIDM. The public hub at dandiarchive.org exposes dandisets through a REST API. Register the archive hub, not each dandiset landing page.

name: Djehuty
description: Djehuty is an open source data repository platform for managing, publishing, and preserving scientific datasets, developed for research data workflows and institutional repositories.
Samvera is an open-source, community-driven repository framework ecosystem for building, managing, preserving, and sharing scholarly and cultural heritage digital collections.
name: Samvera
DataONE
description: DataONE (Data Observation Network for Earth) is a distributed scientific data repository and discovery network that helps researchers preserve, discover, and access Earth and environmental science data across participating member nodes.

ICAT is an open-source scientific data catalog and metadata management platform for large-scale research facilities, supporting dataset discovery, access control, and integration with facility data workflows.
name: ICAT
LORIS
description: LORIS (Longitudinal Online Research and Imaging System) is an open-source web platform from the McGill Centre for Integrative Neuroscience for managing multi-site neuroimaging, clinical, behavioural, and genetic research data. Independent study portals share a REST API and BIDS export.

name: Reactome
description: Reactome is the open-source curated pathway knowledgebase. Public content is available through the website, ContentService REST API, and bulk downloads.

name: ioChem-BD
description: ioChem-BD is a distributed repository for computational chemistry results. Create (daily data management), Browse (DSpace-based public collections with DOI and OAI-PMH), and Find (central Solr/RDKit index) modules are deployed as institutional nodes that sync public items to the ioChem-BD Find service.
ERDDAP is an open-source scientific data server for publishing and accessing tabular and gridded environmental datasets through web services, APIs, and multiple machine-readable download formats.

owner.name: NOAA NMFS Southwest Fisheries Science Center

name: ERDDAP
VEuPathDB
description: VEuPathDB is the Eukaryotic Pathogen, Vector and Host Informatics Resource. Organism sites (AmoebaDB, CryptoDB, FungiDB, GiardiaDB, HostDB, MicrosporidiaDB, PiroplasmaDB, PlasmoDB, ToxoDB, TrichDB, TriTrypDB, VectorBase, and the VEuPathDB hub) plus OrthoMCL, ClinEpiDB, and MicrobiomeDB share the EuPathDB Web Development Kit (WDK) for genome, isolate, experiment, and related data with a common search-strategy UI and REST web services.

owner.name: VEuPathDB (University of Pennsylvania / University of Georgia)

name: AMBIT
description: Reusable cheminformatics data management and web services software implementing OpenTox interfaces and eNanoMapper extensions. Publishes chemical and nanomaterial datasets, substance descriptions, experimental studies and models.

name: Shanoir
description: Shanoir-NG (SHAring iN vivO Imaging Resources) is an open-source web platform from Inria Empenn for importing, sharing, archiving, and visualizing medical imaging studies (MRI, CT, PET, EEG). Independent clinical and preclinical instances share a study catalog and DICOM/NIfTI/BIDS export.

name: Symbiota
description: Symbiota is open-source software for digitally curating and publicly serving biodiversity specimen data. Theme-based portals publish occurrence records, images, checklists, and Darwin Core datasets from natural history collections, with public search, mapping, and RSS/REST exports.

owner.name: Symbiota Support Hub, University of Kansas Biodiversity Institute

name: FLAT
description: Fedora Language Archiving Technology is a reusable CLARIN-compatible language resource repository based on Fedora Commons and Islandora, with Component Metadata support, resource discovery and preservation workflows.

name: Daiquiri
description: Reusable framework for publishing scientific databases through configurable websites, SQL and ADQL query interfaces, IVOA TAP services, table metadata and data downloads. Developed at the Leibniz Institute for Astrophysics Potsdam.

Islandora is an open-source digital repository framework built on Drupal and Fedora for managing, preserving, and providing access to scholarly and cultural heritage content with flexible metadata and workflow extensions.
name: Islandora

description: CONTENTdm is OCLC's hosted digital collections platform for libraries, archives, and museums. It publishes Dublin Core metadata through a JSON website API and dmwebservices, supports OAI-PMH and IIIF, and can hold research datasets alongside cultural heritage objects.
name: CONTENTdm
LabKey Server
description: LabKey Server is a platform for integrating, analyzing, and publishing assay, clinical, and proteomics study data. Public projects such as Panorama Public and the Open Research Portal share the LabKey folder/project UI and begin.view study workspaces.

name: BioDare2
description: BioDare2 is MIT-licensed software for sharing and analysing circadian timeseries. The University of Edinburgh operates one public hub at biodare2.ed.ac.uk with a JSON API at /api/experiments. Register that hub, not each experiment or period-analysis job.

name: ChecklistBank
description: ChecklistBank is Catalogue of Life's open platform for publishing, versioning, and analysing taxonomic checklists. It powers global species lists with a public dataset catalog, downloads, and a documented REST API.

MyCoRe is an open-source framework for building scientific repositories and digital library platforms with modular metadata workflows, OAI-PMH support, and flexible integrations for institutional and domain-specific collections.
name: MyCore
FlyBase
description: FlyBase is the Drosophila melanogaster model-organism knowledgebase, publishing genes, genomes, stocks, and related datasets with bulk downloads.

name: DBpedia Databus
description: DBpedia Databus is the open dataset catalog and versioning bus for DBpedia and related Linked Data artifacts. Distinct from the DBpedia Association WordPress homepage.

name: CELLxGENE Discover
description: CZ CELLxGENE Discover is the public catalog of curated single-cell datasets from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. The data portal and explorer are MIT-licensed. Register the Discover hub, not each h5ad explorer session or Census snapshot as a separate catalog.

name: ESA Science Archive
description: ESA Science Data Centre archives for space-science missions (Gaia, XMM-Newton, Herschel, Planck, Euclid, ISO, and related ESAC hosts) share TAP/VOSI query services and a common science-archive UI for observations and high-level data products.

EPrints is an open-source repository platform for managing, preserving, and sharing scholarly publications and research data via institutional and subject repositories with standards-based interoperability.
name: EPrints
iDigBio
description: iDigBio is the US national biodiversity-collections digitization portal (NSF ADBC). The public specimen/dataset catalog is the iDigBio Portal, with a REST search API. Distinct from the iDigBio IPT (`ipt`).

name: DiVA Portal
description: DiVA Portal (Digitala Vetenskapliga Arkivet) is the shared institutional publication and research-data archive used by Swedish universities and research organisations. Tenants live at {org}.diva-portal.org with a JSF smash search UI. Distinct from DIVA-GIS species-occurrence downloads.

name: MINERVA
description: MINERVA (Molecular Interaction NEtwoRk VisuAlization) is an open-source web platform from LCSB Luxembourg for hosting, annotating, and exploring SBGN-compliant pathway and disease maps. Independent instances share a REST API; MINERVA-Net is the public registry of registered maps.

owner.name: Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine (LCSB), University of Luxembourg

name: NOMAD
description: NOMAD (Novel Materials Discovery) is a repository and Oasis software stack for computational materials-science data. The central laboratory archive and self-hosted Oasis instances share a REST API for uploads, entries, and parser metadata.

RADAR (Research Data Repository) is a research data repository platform developed and operated by FIZ Karlsruhe for archiving and publishing research datasets with DOIs, OAI-PMH harvesting, and a REST API. It is offered as RADAR Cloud and as institutional RADAR Local instances.

owner.name: FIZ Karlsruhe – Leibniz Institute for Information Infrastructure

name: RADAR
HydroShare
description: HydroShare is CUAHSI's open-source hydrologic data and model sharing platform. The public hub at hydroshare.org exposes resources through a REST API at /hsapi/. Register the archive hub, not each resource landing page or the companion THREDDS node.

owner.name: Consortium of Universities for the Advancement of Hydrologic Science, Inc.

name: DLCM
description: DLCM (Data Life Cycle Management) is the swissuniversities OAIS research-data platform developed at the University of Geneva. Public tenants such as Yareta use an Angular catalog UI and a public OAI-PMH provider on the access module (/oai-info/oai-provider/oai).

name: Redivis
description: Redivis is a hosted research-data platform for academic organizations. Institutions get an organization workspace ({org}.redivis.com) where researchers can publish, discover, query, and extract versioned tabular datasets.
MyTardis is an open-source research data management and repository platform designed to capture, organize, publish, and share scientific datasets with rich metadata and workflow integration.
name: MyTardis
EvalAI
description: EvalAI is a BSD-licensed open-source platform for hosting and evaluating AI challenges. The public hub is eval.ai. Register that hub, not each challenge or leaderboard. Docker Compose deployments are documented for independent installations.

name: GBIF Integrated Publishing Toolkit (IPT)
description: GBIF Integrated Publishing Toolkit (IPT) is an open source platform for publishing and managing biodiversity datasets and metadata using community standards, with support for dataset versioning, indexing, and machine-readable exports.

name: FROST-Server
description: FROST-Server is Fraunhofer IOSB's open-source implementation of the OGC SensorThings API. Public instances expose a JSON catalog of Things, Datastreams, Sensors, and Observations, often under /FROST-Server/v1.1/ or /v1.1/, with a default HTML start page titled Start Page or a branded SensorThings title.

name: BRAHMS Online
description: Reusable web publishing component of BRAHMS for natural history collections, herbaria, botanic gardens and taxonomic projects. Independently installed servers publish selected collection data through project-specific websites.

OPeNDAP is an open-source data access protocol and software ecosystem that enables remote subsetting and retrieval of scientific array and tabular data from distributed servers over HTTP. Deployments positively identified as the OPeNDAP Hyrax server use the separate opendaphyrax software ID.
name: OPeNDAP
TR32DB
description: TR32DB is the University of Cologne CRC research-data management system first built for DFG CRC/TR32 and reused for CRC1211DB and TRR228DB. Public tenants share /site/index.php, /extLib/jquery/, and /lib/js/generic/helper.js plus newLogin.js. Distinct from CRC806DB, which is a different SPA. Do not set tr32db from a generic CRC homepage.

Invenio is CERN's open-source digital library and repository framework (classic Invenio, not InvenioRDM) for managing publications and research outputs with MARC/JSON metadata, OAI-PMH, and REST APIs.
name: Invenio
XNAT
description: XNAT is an open-source neuroimaging informatics platform for archiving and sharing imaging sessions, subjects, and derived datasets. Independent hospital and consortium installs expose a REST API and project catalog.

owner.name: Neuroinformatics Research Group, Washington University in St. Louis

name: Atlas of Living Australia
description: Atlas of Living Australia (ALA) is Australia's national biodiversity data platform for discovering species occurrence records, collections, and ecological information. It provides web interfaces and APIs for search, filtering, mapping, and bulk downloads of biodiversity datasets contributed by many institutions.
